selected_evidence.summary: Blacklist config created and modprobe usb-storage (including forced) fails with 'Invalid argument' due to the install /bin/false override, proving it cannot load at runtime.

selected_evidence.requirement: usb-storage module load prevented after reboot (persistent)
selected_evidence.summary: initramfs rebuilt and confirmed to contain the blacklist config; after actual reboot, modprobe usb-storage still fails and the module remains unloaded, plus the config file is intact.

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity, module state)
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id=28ae5f98... and uptime_since, confirming usb_storage not loaded before restart.
sudo reboot issued and exec stream disconnected as acknowledgement that the restart command executed before disconnecting the node.
Polling showed a connection timeout during reboot, then successful exec once the node came back up.

selected_evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity (actual restart, not just service restart)
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id=b931f7ed... differs from the pre-restart boot_id=28ae5f98..., proving the kernel actually restarted.
After reboot, usb_storage remains unloaded, the blacklist config file is present and unchanged, and modprobe usb-storage still fails as intended.
